item.title: Snow limits flights from Copenhagen Airport
item.description: Significant delays and numerous cancellations were reported at Copenhagen Airport due to snow on Friday morning. Restrictions on the number of flights taking off per hour have been imposed, impacting the day’s expected traffic. item.title: Snowplows run in Copenhagen’s streets for first time in 15 years
item.description: In Copenhagen Municipality, snowplows have been used for the first time in 15 years due to significant winter weather. Approximately 160 machines, including snowplows, are deployed to clear roads, bike paths, and sidewalks. item.title: Copenhagen Metro sets passenger record for three consecutive days
item.description: The cold and windy winter weather has led to a significant increase in the usage of the Copenhagen metro this week. Metroselskabet reported that passenger records were set on Monday, Tuesday, and Wednesday. item.title: Meteorologists record most snow in Copenhagen since 2011
item.description: The Danish Meteorological Institute (DMI) reported 17 centimeters of snow in Copenhagen, marking the second highest recorded snow depth since 2011. The highest was 18.7 centimeters in January 2011. Challenges from the winter weather led Copenhagen to deploy snowplows for the first time in 15 years, with about 160 machines in use. item.title: “Design is embedded in Danish culture”: Designmuseum director Anne-Louise Sommer on how Danish design helps internationals understand Denmark
item.description: Designmuseum director Anne-Louise Sommer discusses heritage, craftsmanship, sustainability, and why international visitors notice Danish design more clearly than locals often do.

item.description: The EU Commission has announced that TikTok must change its “addictive design” to avoid large fines from the EU. item.title: Holding Steady in Unsettled Times: Psychological tools for coping with uncertainty and anxiety as an expat
item.description: Many expats are physically distant from family, long-standing friendships, and familiar support systems. When global events add another layer of unpredictability, it can intensify feelings of loneliness, uncertainty or doubt.
